name: Disneyland Main Street & Grand Californian Holiday Soft Gingerbread Mickey Cookie & Sugar Cookie
brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday, Market House & Grand Californian Lobby Cart (Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Disney's famous plush-soft Mickey Gingerbread Cookie (sold at Jolly Holiday and the Grand Californian lobby cart during the holidays) is baked with refined flour, molasses, and gut-soothing ginger with zero nuts or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a soft Mickey Gingerbread Cookie with chocolate-dipped ears and share half with warm herbal tea or hot cocoa (with lactase).
watchOuts: High sugar in the royal icing—enjoy half a cookie at a time
